why: phase-428 W6 remainder (2026-09-06) — ledgered because the correlator's return-type comparison became a VERDICT. `rclcpp::GuardCondition::trigger()` returns `void` (it throws `rclcpp::exceptions::RCLError` on failure); ours (`packages/api/nros-cpp/include/rclcpp/guard_condition.hpp:50`) returns `Result`.
